names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νίκων ο «Μετανοεῖτε»», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 26. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Никон „Покајаније“.“ — «Преп.» is Преподобни, the `venerable` grade this folder already keeps, so it comes off; «Покајаније» is NOT a rank but the by-name the book explains in the body, Repentance, from the Repent! he never stopped crying, and it is kept with the book’s own quotation marks around it exactly as the heading prints them, because a form is copied and not edited. Measured before it was written, with and without the quotation marks, which the fold strips as it strips parentheses: the string stands on no other folder. THE BARE «Никон» WAS DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN — it already stands on `nikon-disciple-of-kuksha` and `nikon-of-sicily`, and this heading gave a fuller form, which BRIEF-SERBIAN §6 asks for.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Νίκων γεννήθηκε μεταξύ των ετών 920 - 925 μ.Χ.» — the page's own interval.

death.note: saint.gr heads the page «Οσιος Νικων ο «μετανοειτε» (; - 998)» and the narrative repeats it: «άφησε την τελευταία του πνοή το έτος 998 μ.Χ.»

hymns.text: Χαίρει ἔχουσα ἡ Λακεδαίμων, θείαν λάρνακα, τῶν σῶν λειψάνων, ἀναβρύουσαν πηγὰς τῶν ἰάσεων, καὶ διασώζουσαν πάντας ἐκ θλίψεων, τοὺς σοὶ προστρέχοντας Πάτερ ἐκ πίστεως. Νίκων Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Νίκων ο «Μετανοεῖτε»». It names him and no other saint.

english.text: Lakedaimon rejoices in having the divine casket of your relics, which wells up springs of healings and saves from afflictions all who run to you, father, in faith. Venerable Nikon, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὴν Ἀγγελικὴν μιμούμενος πολιτείαν, κόσμου τὰ τερπνὰ ὡς σκύβαλα ἐλογίσω, μετανοίας τὴν τρίβον δεικνύων ἡμῖν, θεοφόρε Νίκων Ὅσιε· διὰ τοῦτό σε γεραίρομεν, ἐκτελοῦντες νῦν τὴν μνήμην σου· ὑπάρχεις γὰρ ἀληθῶς, ἰαμάτων πηγή.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. β’, Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πληρώσας — on the page of «Όσιος Νίκων ο «Μετανοεῖτε»». It names him and no other saint.

english.text: Imitating the life of the Angels, you reckoned the world's delights as refuse, showing us the path of repentance, God-bearing and venerable Nikon. For this we honour you as we keep your memory now; for you are truly a spring of healings.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νίκων ο «Μετανοεῖτε»»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3093/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's five Nikon folders is this man: they are kept on other days and none is the preacher of Lakedaimon. The epithet in the display name is the page's own «ο «Μετανοεῖτε»», after the one word he went about repeating, and it is not a rank, so nothing is put in `types` from it; `preacher` and `wonderworker` are the page's own account of what he did. The page makes him patron of Sparta. No `locations` are proposed: the page names Pontus, Crete, Gortyna, the Peloponnese, Euboea and Chalkis, and a life of that reach cannot be put on one point. Both hymns name him and no other saint and both carry an ἦχος and a model, so both are taken. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.12.2025 (26. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Никон „Покајаније“.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry. THE `[~]` HINT MARKED THIS LINE AND IS WRONG ABOUT IT: the quoted word in the heading made the adapter read the line as a feast or a title rather than a person, and the body is a man’s life from his birth in Armenia to his repose at Sparta. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book’s «Скончао у Спарти 998. год.» is exactly the 998 this folder already holds from saint.gr, and it gives no year of birth to set against the «between 920 and 925» the folder holds. No `locations`: the folder has none and the entry names Armenia, Anatolia, the Peloponnese and Sparta without placing him at any of them for a span this reader could bound, and a located saint with no bounded span is work for `map-span.test.mjs`’s UNDATED list. No `related` row: the entry names no other person at all. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: his Armenian birth; THE WORDS OF THE LORD THAT MOVED HIM — that everyone who leaves father or mother will receive a hundredfold and inherit eternal life — and his leaving everything for Christ for a monastery and the tonsure; his going out of the monastery once perfected in every virtue, to preach the Gospel to men; THE UNCEASING CRY «ПОКАЈТЕ СЕ!», Repent, which is what got him the by-name the heading puts in quotation marks; his circuit of the whole of Anatolia and the Peloponnese; the wonders worked by prayer in the name of Christ; and the peaceful passing to his beloved Lord at Sparta.
